shares-mount.absolute.message: The mount point is an absolute path.
shares-mount.absolute.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path doesn't start with /.

shares-mount.root.message: The mount point can't be the guest's root.
shares-mount.root.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path is /.

shares-mount.control.message: The mount point can't have control characters.
shares-mount.control.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path has a control character.

shares-mount.tooLong.message: The mount point is too long.
shares-mount.tooLong.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path, or its systemd unit's name, is over 255 bytes.

shares-mount.characters.message: The mount point can't have "%", or end in a space or "\" (systemd reads them otherwise).
shares-mount.characters.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path has a character systemd would read otherwise.

shares-mount.plainly.message: Write the mount point plainly: no "." or "..", no "//", no "/" at the end.
shares-mount.plainly.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path isn't written plainly.

shares-mount.guestOwn.message: {{path}} is the guest's own: mounting there would hide it.
shares-mount.guestOwn.note: Warning under the Mount point field (Machines page, Shared folders tab), and the error when such settings are saved: the path is one of the guest's own directories. {{path}} is the path written.

folders.defaultName.note: A new folder's name when none is given (Folder wizard: the Name field's placeholder; Shared folders on the Machines page), made unique with a number when taken.

folders.folderGone.note: Error (Machines page, Shared folders) when a folder is renamed or changed after another tab deleted it. Lowercase, as a short reason.

folders.machineGone.note: Error (Machines page, Folders tab, the toolbar's Folders menu) when a folder is attached to, detached from or moved in a machine another tab deleted. Lowercase, as a short reason.

folders.tooMany.message: {{name}} has {{max}} folders, the most a machine has.
folders.tooMany.note: Error (Folder wizard, Folders tab) when a folder is attached to a machine that has the most it may. {{name}} is the machine's name; {{max}} that most (16).

folders-page.inUse.message: A machine has this folder: power it off or detach it first.
folders-page.inUse.note: Error on the Machines page (Shared folders) when files are added, copied in or out, or the folder emptied while a machine has the folder.

folders-page.inUseElsewhere.message: {{name}} is in use by a machine in another tab: power it off there first.
folders-page.inUseElsewhere.note: Error on the Machines page (Shared folders) when a folder a machine in another tab has is deleted. {{name}} is the folder's name.

folders-live.detachFirst.message: Detach it first: the machine has it now.
folders-live.detachFirst.note: Error on the Machines page's Folders tab when Read-only is changed on a folder the machine running on this page has.

Folders.kind.host.note: Under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab): it is a folder on the user's computer.

Folders.kind.opfs.note: Under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab): it is a folder kept by the browser.

Folders.kind.readOnly.note: Under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab) when the folder itself is read-only. {{kind}} is where it is (Folders.kind.host or Folders.kind.opfs).

Folders.gone.message: A folder gone from this browser
Folders.gone.note: Name shown for an attached folder whose record another tab deleted (Machines page, Folders tab).

Folders.held.note: Under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab), after ' · ': a machine in another tab has it.

Folders.noPermission.note: Warning under an attached host folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab) while the machine runs here and the browser needs a click to grant it (Allow… beside).

Folders.inUseBy.note: Warning under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab) while another machine, in another tab, has it. {{holder}} is that machine's name.

Folders.inUse.message: In use by a machine in another tab
Folders.inUse.note: Warning under an attached folder's name (Machines page, Folders tab) while another machine, whose tab didn't say its name, has it.

Folders.busy.saving.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder's Read-only is saved.

Folders.readOnly.title.note: Tooltip of an attached folder's Read-only checkbox (Machines page, Folders tab): for this machine's attachment.

Folders.readOnly.note: Checkbox on an attached folder's line (Machines page, Folders tab): this machine only reads it.

Folders.busy.moving.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while an attached folder moves in the list.

Folders.busy.asking.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while the browser asks for a folder's permission.

Folders.allow.note: Button on an attached host folder the browser needs a click for (Machines page, Folders tab): asks for its permission.

Folders.busy.taking.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder another machine has is taken for this one.

Folders.useHere.note: Button on an attached folder another machine has (Machines page, Folders tab): asks, then takes it for this machine.

Folders.busy.detaching.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder is detached.

Folders.detach.note: Button on each attached folder (Machines page, Folders tab): detaches it from the machine.

Folders.none.note: The Machines page's Folders tab's list when the machine has no folder attached.

Folders.attach.note: Button under the attached folders (Machines page, Folders tab): opens the Folder wizard.

Folders.note.message: A folder is attached or detached at once, running or not: the guest finds it under the mount point by its name.
Folders.note.note: Note at the bottom of the Machines page's Folders tab.

FoldersMenu.state.permission.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: the browser needs a click to grant it (Allow access to… below).

FoldersMenu.state.heldBy.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: a machine in another tab has it. {{holder}} is that machine's name.

FoldersMenu.state.held.message: in use by a machine in another tab
FoldersMenu.state.held.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: a machine in another tab, which didn't say its name, has it.

FoldersMenu.state.missing.message: not in this browser any more
FoldersMenu.state.missing.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: another tab deleted the folder.

FoldersMenu.state.failed.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: it couldn't be opened. {{why}} is the browser's error message.

FoldersMenu.state.readOnly.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: the machine has it and only reads it.

FoldersMenu.state.readWrite.note: State beside an attached folder's name in the toolbar's Folders menu: the machine has it, and reads and writes it.

FoldersMenu.title.note: Tooltip of the toolbar's Folders menu button.

FoldersMenu.allow.note: Button under an attached host folder in the toolbar's Folders menu when the browser needs a click to grant it. {{name}} is the folder's name.

FoldersMenu.useHere.note: Button under an attached folder another machine has, in the toolbar's Folders menu: asks, then takes it.

FoldersMenu.detach.note: Button under each attached folder in the toolbar's Folders menu: detaches it from the machine.

FoldersMenu.none.note: The toolbar's Folders menu's list when the machine has no folder attached.

FoldersMenu.attach.note: Button in the toolbar's Folders menu: opens the Folder wizard.

FoldersMenu.where.message: In the guest: <path>{{path}}</path>. A guest without systemd 256 mounts them by hand: <command>…</command>
FoldersMenu.where.note: Note at the bottom of the toolbar's Folders menu when the page mounts the folders. <path> is shown as code: the mount point {{path}} followed by /<name>; <command> is replaced by the mount command to type (its words here aren't shown).

FoldersMenu.where.byHand.message: A guest without systemd 256 mounts them by hand: <command>…</command>
FoldersMenu.where.byHand.note: Note at the bottom of the toolbar's Folders menu when the page doesn't mount the folders. <command> is replaced by the mount command to type, shown as code (its words here aren't shown).

FolderWizard.state.heldBy.note: Under a folder to pick in the Folder wizard's first step: a machine in another tab has it. {{holder}} is that machine's name.

FolderWizard.state.held.message: in use by a machine in another tab
FolderWizard.state.held.note: Under a folder to pick in the Folder wizard's first step: a machine in another tab, which didn't say its name, has it.

FolderWizard.state.host.note: Under a folder to pick in the Folder wizard's first step: it is a folder on the user's computer.

FolderWizard.state.opfs.note: Under a folder to pick in the Folder wizard's first step: it is a folder kept by the browser.

FolderWizard.state.readOnly.note: Under a read-only folder to pick in the Folder wizard's first step. {{state}} is who has it or where it is (FolderWizard.state.*).

FolderWizard.title.pick.note: Title of the Folder wizard (a dialog) at its first step: pick one of the browser's folders or make a new one.

FolderWizard.title.new.note: Title of the Folder wizard when a new folder is made (its kind, then its settings).

FolderWizard.pick.note.message: A folder is kept by this browser, for any of its machines. Several machines can read one; one that writes has it alone.
FolderWizard.pick.note.note: Text at the top of the Folder wizard's first step, above the folders to pick.

FolderWizard.pick.new.note: Title of the first choice in the Folder wizard's first step: make a new folder instead.

FolderWizard.pick.new.text.message: On this computer, or in the browser.
FolderWizard.pick.new.text.note: Text under New folder… in the Folder wizard's first step.

FolderWizard.pick.readOnly.note: Checkbox under the folders to pick in the Folder wizard: the machine attaches the picked folder read-only.

FolderWizard.kind.note: Question at the top of the Folder wizard's kind step, above the two kinds.

FolderWizard.kind.host.note: Title of the first kind in the Folder wizard: a folder the user picks on the computer.

FolderWizard.kind.host.text.message: You pick it; the machine reads and writes the files themselves. Writing into a big file is slow: each session copies it (SQLite databases and disk images belong in the browser's kind, or on a disk).
FolderWizard.kind.host.text.note: Explanation under A folder on this computer in the Folder wizard's kind step.

FolderWizard.kind.opfs.message: A new folder in the browser
FolderWizard.kind.opfs.note: Title of the second kind in the Folder wizard: a folder the browser keeps.

FolderWizard.kind.opfs.text.message: Kept by this browser beside its disks, fast for any kind of writing. Files go in and out through its card, under Shared folders on the Machines page.
FolderWizard.kind.opfs.text.note: Explanation under A new folder in the browser in the Folder wizard's kind step.

FolderWizard.readOnly.note: Checkbox in the Folder wizard's settings for a new folder: no machine writes it.

FolderWizard.host.read.message: Pick the folder next: the browser asks whether this page may read it, and refuses a few (your home directory itself, system ones).
FolderWizard.host.read.note: Note in the Folder wizard before a folder on the computer is picked, with Read-only on.

FolderWizard.host.readWrite.message: Pick the folder next: the browser asks whether this page may read and write it, and refuses a few (your home directory itself, system ones).
FolderWizard.host.readWrite.note: Note in the Folder wizard before a folder on the computer is picked, with Read-only off.

FolderWizard.name.note: Label of the name field for a new folder in the browser (Folder wizard).

FolderWizard.back.note: Button of the Folder wizard: goes back a step.

FolderWizard.cancel.note: Button of the Folder wizard: closes it without doing anything.

FolderWizard.choose.note: Button of the Folder wizard for a folder on the computer: opens the browser's folder picker.

FolderWizard.attach.note: Button of the Folder wizard, opened for a machine: attaches the picked or new folder to it.

FolderWizard.create.note: Button of the Folder wizard, opened from Shared folders on the Machines page (no machine): makes the new folder.

FoldersPane.busy.adding.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while files are added to a folder in the browser (Shared folders).

FoldersPane.busy.copyingOut.note: What the Machines page is doing while a folder in the browser is copied into a folder on the computer (shown with … at its top, and in the copy's progress line).

FoldersPane.busy.copyingIn.note: What the Machines page is doing while a folder on the computer is copied into a folder in the browser (shown with … at its top, and in the copy's progress line).

FoldersPane.empty.question.message: Empty {{name}}? Its files are deleted from this browser.
FoldersPane.empty.question.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Empty is clicked under a folder in the browser (Machines page, Shared folders). {{name}} is the folder's name.

FoldersPane.empty.title.note: Title of the confirm dialog that asks before a folder in the browser is emptied.

FoldersPane.empty.ok.note: OK button of the confirm dialog that asks before a folder in the browser is emptied.

FoldersPane.busy.emptying.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder in the browser is emptied.

FoldersPane.delete.opfs.lose_one.message: Delete {{name}}? Its files ({{size, bytes}}) are deleted from this browser. {{machines}} loses it.
FoldersPane.delete.opfs.lose_one.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder in the browser attached to one machine (Machines page, Shared folders). {{name}} is the folder's name, {{size}} its files' size, {{machines}} the machine's name.

FoldersPane.delete.opfs.lose_other.message: Delete {{name}}? Its files ({{size, bytes}}) are deleted from this browser. {{machines}} lose it.
FoldersPane.delete.opfs.lose_other.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder in the browser attached to several machines. {{name}} is the folder's name, {{size}} its files' size, {{machines}} the machines' names, joined with commas; {{count}} how many.

FoldersPane.delete.opfs.message: Delete {{name}}? Its files ({{size, bytes}}) are deleted from this browser.
FoldersPane.delete.opfs.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder in the browser attached to no machine (Machines page, Shared folders). {{name}} is the folder's name, {{size}} its files' size.

FoldersPane.delete.host.lose_one.message: Delete {{name}}? The folder on this computer stays as it is. {{machines}} loses it.
FoldersPane.delete.host.lose_one.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder on the computer attached to one machine (Machines page, Shared folders). {{name}} is the folder's name, {{machines}} the machine's name.

FoldersPane.delete.host.lose_other.message: Delete {{name}}? The folder on this computer stays as it is. {{machines}} lose it.
FoldersPane.delete.host.lose_other.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder on the computer attached to several machines. {{name}} is the folder's name, {{machines}} the machines' names, joined with commas; {{count}} how many.

FoldersPane.delete.host.message: Delete {{name}}? The folder on this computer stays as it is.
FoldersPane.delete.host.note: Question (confirm dialog) when Delete is clicked on a folder on the computer attached to no machine (Machines page, Shared folders). {{name}} is the folder's name.

FoldersPane.delete.title.note: Title of the confirm dialog that asks before a folder is deleted (Machines page, Shared folders).

FoldersPane.delete.ok.note: OK button of the confirm dialog that asks before a folder is deleted.

FoldersPane.busy.deleting.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder is deleted.

FoldersPane.name.note: Screen-reader name of a folder's name field, which renames it (Machines page, Shared folders, at the top of each folder's card).

FoldersPane.busy.renaming.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder is renamed.

FoldersPane.kind.host.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders): it is a folder on the user's computer.

FoldersPane.kind.opfs.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders): it is a folder kept by the browser.

FoldersPane.attachedTo.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders), after ' · '. {{machines}} is the names of the machines it is attached to, joined with commas.

FoldersPane.attachedToNone.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders), after ' · ': no machine has it attached.

FoldersPane.heldElsewhere.message: a machine in another tab has it
FoldersPane.heldElsewhere.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders), after ' · ': a running machine in another tab has it.

FoldersPane.heldHere.note: Under a folder's name on its card (Machines page, Shared folders), after ' · ': the machine running on this page has it.

FoldersPane.busy.saving.note: What the Machines page is doing (shown with … at its top) while a folder's Read-only is saved (Shared folders).

FoldersPane.readOnly.title.note: Tooltip of a folder's Read-only checkbox on its card (Machines page, Shared folders): for every machine.

FoldersPane.readOnly.note: Checkbox on a folder's card (Machines page, Shared folders): no machine writes it.

FoldersPane.files.note: Button on a folder in the browser's card (Machines page, Shared folders): shows or hides its files.

FoldersPane.delete.note: Button on each folder's card (Machines page, Shared folders): deletes the folder (asked first).

FoldersPane.files.label.note: Screen-reader name of the region that lists a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders); files dropped on it are added.

FoldersPane.files.empty.note: The list of a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders) when it has none.

FoldersPane.busyNote.message: A machine has this folder: its files change only when it lets it go.
FoldersPane.busyNote.note: Note under a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders) while a machine has it (the buttons are off).

FoldersPane.add.note: Button under a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders): opens the browser's file picker.

FoldersPane.copyOut.message: Copy into a folder on this computer…
FoldersPane.copyOut.note: Button under a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders): copies them into a folder the user picks.

FoldersPane.copyIn.message: Copy from a folder on this computer…
FoldersPane.copyIn.note: Button under a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders): copies a folder the user picks into it.

FoldersPane.empty.note: Button under a folder in the browser's files (Machines page, Shared folders): deletes all its files (asked first).

FoldersPane.copying.note: Progress line under a folder's files while a copy runs (Machines page, Shared folders); a Cancel button follows. {{what}} is Copying out or Copying in; {{done}} the files copied; {{total}} how many there are (… until counted); {{bytes}} the bytes copied.

FoldersPane.copying.cancel.note: Button after a copy's progress line (Machines page, Shared folders): stops the copy.

FoldersPane.none.message: No folders yet: make one here, or from a machine's Shared folders tab. A folder dropped on this page becomes one.
FoldersPane.none.note: Shared folders on the Machines page when the browser keeps no folder.
